turns.reply:
I made two small fixes in `rich/cells.py` for zero-width-joiner (ZWJ) edge cases and submitted the patch. The issue text was vague, so I inferred the bugs from the code rather than from a reproduction.

- **`_cell_len`:** a string ending in a ZWJ no longer raises `StopIteration`, because `next()` now has a `None` default.
- **`split_graphemes`:** a ZWJ at the end of a string no longer pushes the span's end past the string length, because the index is clamped to `codepoint_count`.

`tests/test_cells.py` passes (54 tests). Checks on `"a\u200d"` and a family ZWJ emoji gave sensible widths and spans. I did not check either fix against the specific behaviours in issues #3947 and #3950, since I did not have their text.
